speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you are experiencing postmenopausal bleeding and have an adnexal mass. To understand the cause, have you had any previous surgeries, and are you currently taking hormone replacement therapy or other medications?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia or Endometrial Carcinoma. (Note: While the patient denied medications, her age and postmenopausal bleeding are the primary drivers for this suspicion; the adnexal mass is a secondary finding requiring further investigation via ultrasound and biopsy).
